Introduction\\n- Temporal abstraction is a long-sought goal in RL (options, macro-actions, skip connections)\\n- World-model RL (DreamerV3) offers a natural testbed: modify imagination dt without changing environment interaction\\n- Puzzle: all our attempts at variable-rate imagination degrade performance. Why?\\n- Contribution: systematic factorial diagnosis identifying trained dt_embedding as the reliable trigger for conditioning-induced value overestimation (CIVO, nve>1.5x), with collapse as a stochastic consequence. The vulnerability is deeper than imagination quality — even dt=1 imagination collapses at the same rate when dt_embedding is trained, revealing that training data dt>1 transitions alone drive the critic exploitation feedback loop\\n\\n### 2. Background & Related Work\\n- Temporal abstraction in model-free RL (options framework, FiGAR, action repeat)\\n- World-model RL (Dreamer family, IRIS, TWM)\\n- Variable-rate planning in world models (few prior works, mostly positive framing)\\n- Value overestimation in model-based RL (delusional bias per Lu et al. 2018 — differentiate from our CIVO)\\n\\n### 3. Methodology\\n- DreamerV3 as base architecture\\n- Variable-rate imagination: dt_embedding, temporal subsampling, learned gating\\n- **Factorial experiment design**: 2×2×2 grid (dt_embedding trained/untrained × subsample ON/OFF × H=8/15) + baselines\\n- Diagnostic metrics: eval return, value/eval ratio as overestimation proxy, learning curves\\n\\n### 4. Results\\n- **Finding 1**: All dt>1 configurations degrade (C1)\\n- **Finding 2**: Controlled ablation isolates trained dt_embedding (C2) — the \\\"smoking gun\\\" comparison (008c vs 008d)\\n- **Finding 3**: Untrained dt_embedding prevents optimistic drift, sustaining near-baseline performance (C3)\\n- **Finding 4**: Longer dt amplifies (C4)\\n- **Finding 5**: Horizon/subsample effects are secondary (C5)\\n- **Finding 6 (partially falsified)**: dt=1 imagination does not prevent collapse (1/2 seeds), but collapsed seed (008e_v3_s2) shows non-CIVO dynamics (eval-driven, entropy ↑) unlike 008d's classic CIVO (value-driven, entropy ↓). 009a baseline s2 stable → collapse is config-caused. Trained dt_embedding creates vulnerability through multiple pathways, not solely through value overestimation (C6, D040)\\n\\n### 5. Discussion\\n- Mechanism: why trained dt_embedding causes CIVO (RSSM fidelity gap at dt>1)\\n- RSSM fidelity analysis: 008d reward gap (2.78x) vs 008f reward gap (1.01x) — trained dt_emb 让 reward head 在 dt=2 时产生系统性偏差，这是 critic 被误导的直接来源\\n- 008f 的 reward 退化 trade-off：去掉 dt_embedding 避免崩塌但牺牲 reward 预测质量\\n- **D040: Multiple vulnerability pathways**: 008e_v3_s2 在 dt=1 imagination 下崩溃 (nve=3.78x@105K)，但机制与 008d 的 CIVO 不同：008d = value explosion → eval decline → entropy ↓；008e_v3_s2 = eval crash → value stable → entropy ↑。009a baseline s2 稳定排除 seed 脆弱。Trained dt_embedding creates vulnerability through multiple pathways: Pathway A (CIVO, value-driven) requires dt>1 imagination; Pathway B (non-CIVO policy instability, eval-driven) operates independently of imagination dt\\n- Connection to existing theory: non-delusional Q-learning (Lu et al., 2018), model exploitation in MBRL\\n- Why this is specific to world-model RL (model-free temporal abstraction doesn't suffer the same failure mode)\\n- **D032: Value self-correction mechanism (009b)**: 009b (008d seed 2) demonstrates that pathological overestimation (nve>1.5x) is not always irreversible. Value peaked at 110.9@65K then monotonically self-corrected to 67.3@105K, while eval simultaneously improved (172→268). Hypothesized mechanism: when the critic's overestimation does not yet dominate the actor's gradient signal (transient vs sustained nve>1.5x), the actor can still learn from real environment returns, creating a corrective force. In 008d seed 1, the sustained overestimation (3 consecutive checkpoints >1.5x at 35K+) overwhelmed this correction. The bifurcation likely depends on early training stochasticity — initialization and data sampling order determine whether the overestimation feedback loop locks in before correction can take hold (consistent with primacy bias in MBRL, Qiao et al. 2023; early outlier runs, Bjorck et al. 2022). This makes nve>1.5x a **necessary condition** for collapse but not sufficient — the temporal persistence of overestimation is the second gate.\\n\\n### 6. Implications for Future Work\\n- **D038 update**: dt=1 imagination is NOT sufficient — trained dt_embedding in critic is the fundamental vulnerability, regardless of imagination strategy\\n- Don't use trained dt_embedding for temporal conditioning in imagination-based actor-critic training without safeguards (TAWM shows this works in MPC — the vulnerability is specific to imagination-based training)\\n- RSSM prediction quality must improve before variable-rate imagination is viable\\n- Potential safeguards: (a) ~~detach dt_embedding gradients from reward head~~ **架构层面无效（reward gradient = 0 by design）。梯度分解揭示 dt_emb 的 93% 梯度来自 observation decoders，7% 来自 KL dynamics，reward 贡献为 0。真正的干预目标是 observation decoder→dt_emb 梯度通路（Full-SGS, exp_018 planned）。**, (b) stop-gradient on dt>1 critic targets, (c) pessimistic value ensemble for dt>1 transitions, (d) uncertainty-gated truncation\\n- Need for diagnostic methodology in temporal abstraction research\\n\\n---\\n\\n## Anticipated Reviewer Concerns\\n\\n### R1: \\\"Limited to one environment / one base algorithm\\\"\\n**Pre-emption**: Our claims are mechanistic (trained dt_embedding → value overestimation → collapse). ## Title Candidates

1. **"Why Temporal Abstraction Fails in DreamerV3: A Diagnostic Analysis of Variable-Rate Imagination"**
2. ~~**"The Delusional Critic Problem in DreamerV3's Variable-Rate Imagination"**~~ (deprecated — "delusional critic" conflicts with Lu et al. 2018)
3. **"Diagnosing Value Overestimation from Temporal Abstraction in DreamerV3"** ← preferred after D037 terminology decision
4. **"Conditioning-Induced Value Overestimation in Variable-Rate World-Model Imagination"**

**⚠️ D037 术语决定**: "delusional critic" → **"conditioning-induced value overestimation"** (简称 CIVO)。Lu et al. 2018 的 delusional bias 指 policy-class constraints 导致不可实现的 Q 值，本文机制是 model imprecision + learned conditioning amplification，概念不同。Dream 模拟三档审稿一致指出术语误导。全文替换："delusional critic" → "conditioning-induced value overestimation"，可 cite Lu et al. 2018 as analogy but must explicitly differentiate。

**⚠️ D037 TAWM 对比（关键 novelty 升级）**: TAWM (Nhu et al., ICML 2025) 在 TD-MPC2 (MPC setting) 中成功使用 dt-conditioning。本文发现 dt-conditioning 在 imagination-based actor-critic 中失败 → **novelty 从 "known failure class 的 specific instance" 升级为 "dt-conditioning succeeds in MPC but fails in imagination — here's the architecture-specific vulnerability"**。TAWM 是强化 novelty 的最关键参考文献。

## Venue

**CoRL 2026** — Deadline: 2026-05-29

## Narrative Positioning

This is a **diagnostic analysis paper**, not a method paper. We do not propose a new algorithm. Instead, we provide a systematic, controlled investigation answering: *Why does temporal abstraction fail in world-model RL?*

The contribution is a **strongly supported causal chain** from mechanism to failure mode, backed by a factorial experiment design that isolates each factor, plus a **practical mitigation guideline** (restrict imagination to dt=1 during multi-dt training → 95% baseline recovery). Diagnostic papers are valued when they (a) address a widely-attempted but poorly-understood failure, (b) provide actionable insight for future method design, and (c) are methodologically rigorous.

We scope all claims to **DreamerV3 and its RSSM world model**. Generalizability to other latent-dynamics architectures is discussed but not claimed.

---

## Core Claims

### C1: Variable-rate imagination in DreamerV3 consistently degrades performance

Temporal abstraction via variable dt—whether learned or fixed—degrades asymptotic performance relative to the dt=1 baseline across all tested configurations.

| Evidence | Experiment | Key Metric |
|----------|-----------|------------|
| Baseline stability | exp_001_baseline (dt=1) | Stable convergence ~950 eval return |
| Fixed dt=2 collapse | exp_006_fixed_dt2 (dt=2, subsample ON, H=15) | Peak 485@35K → collapse to ~135@65K |
| Fixed dt=4 severe degradation | exp_007_fixed_dt4 (dt=4) | Peak 176.9@25K, 144.4@45K (33% of baseline@45K=443) |
| Learned gate collapse | exp_005 (learned gate) | Peak 541@55K → 99@145K |

**Strength**: Strong. Three independent dt>1 configurations all show degradation. No positive result exists for variable-rate imagination in our setup.

### C2: Trained dt_embedding reliably triggers pathological value overestimation (>1.5x), creating high collapse risk

**D032 update: nve>1.5x threshold has perfect separating power (4/4); collapse itself is stochastic.**

The trained dt_embedding reliably induces pathological value overestimation (normalized v/e >1.5x baseline) across all tested seeds, but whether this overestimation progresses to catastrophic performance collapse is stochastic:

- **WITH trained dt_emb**: 2/2 seeds exceed nve>1.5x at 35K+ (008d seed 1: sustained 1.71x@35K→2.09x@45K→4.12x@55K → collapse; 009b seed 2: 1.62x@45K → self-correction to 0.38x@105K)
- **WITHOUT dt_emb (008f)**: 0/2 seeds exceed nve>1.5x at 35K+ (seed 1 peak 1.02x@25K; seed 2 peak 1.26x@25K)
- **1.5x threshold (35K+)**: 4/4 perfect classification — reliable diagnostic marker separating trained vs untrained dt_emb

**⚠️ 时间限定**: nve>1.5x 诊断适用于 **35K+ steps**（此时 baseline v/e 已充分收敛至 >0.24，比率稳定可靠）。25K 处 baseline v/e 仅 0.087，微小绝对差异可被放大为大比率（如 009b@25K nve=2.05x 和 008e_v3@25K nve=1.93x 均为 false positive）。论文中报告 threshold 时必须标注此限定。

**Sustained vs transient overestimation**: The key difference between collapse (008d seed 1) and self-correction (009b seed 2) is the **temporal persistence** of nve>1.5x. Seed 1 maintained nve>1.5x across 3 consecutive checkpoints at 35K+ (1.71x@35K→2.09x@45K→4.12x@55K, accelerating), locking the positive feedback loop; seed 2 exceeded 1.5x at 45K (1.62x) but dropped to 1.41x@55K and continued declining, allowing self-correction. This suggests a "point of no return" where sustained overestimation becomes irreversible, with early training stochasticity (initialization, data sampling order) determining which path is taken (cf. Henderson et al. 2018, Bjorck et al. 2022, Qiao et al. 2023).

The trained dt_embedding enables precise dt prediction in imagination, but RSSM state prediction quality at dt>1 is insufficient to support this precision. The result is conditioning-induced value overestimation (CIVO) that drives actor learning toward incorrect policies. Without dt_embedding conditioning, the overestimation feedback loop is blocked entirely (nve never exceeds 1.5x).

**dt_emb Gradient Decomposition (D061)**

梯度验证（torch.autograd.grad analysis, commit 5fc8e49）揭示 dt_emb.weight 的梯度来源分布：

这意味着：(1) 016e 的 reward_dt_emb_detach 是 no-op——detach 了一个不存在的梯度通路；(2) dt_emb 的训练几乎完全由 observation reconstruction loss 驱动；(3) Full-SGS（exp_018）移除 observation decoder 梯度后仅保留 7% KL 梯度，是真正的 gradient-level intervention。

**Strength**: Moderate-strong (D032 update: causal direction + diagnostic marker confirmed; collapse stochastic). The **nve>1.5x threshold** achieves 4/4 perfect separation: all trained dt_emb seeds (008d, 009b) exceed 1.5x; no untrained seeds (008f, 009c) exceed 1.5x. This is the paper's strongest quantitative result for C2. **Collapse** is stochastic (1/2 trained seeds): 008d seed 1 shows sustained nve>1.5x → collapse; 009b seed 2 shows transient nve>1.5x → self-correction. The **causal direction** is unambiguous across all 4 data points. Pending: 009e (008d seed 1) to determine collapse probability (1/3 vs 2/3); 009f (008f seed 1) for third untrained seed; 009c extension to 200K.

### C3: Untrained dt_embedding prevents optimistic drift, substantively protecting performance

When dt_embedding is untrained (random fixed), the value function cannot exploit precise dt information, preventing the optimistic value drift seen in trained variants. This value growth suppression substantively protects performance: exp_008a demonstrates two complete zigzag recovery cycles over 105K steps (peak @105K=778, 85% of baseline 916), with normalized v/e consistently suppressed at 0.59-0.93x baseline. The trained dt_embedding variant (exp_006) collapses catastrophically as its v/e ratio accelerates far past baseline levels (2.3x baseline@55K).

| Sustained v/e suppression | exp_008a | v/e: 37.6%@55K → 37.2%@65K → 53.6%@75K → 47.5%@85K → 49.7%@95K → 38.6%@105K. Normalized v/e: 0.93x→0.66x→0.75x→0.68x→0.79x→0.59x baseline. Consistently below 1.0x, no acceleration. |

**Strength**: Strong (B+ confirmed with 105K long-run data). Two complete zigzag recovery cycles (501→608→470→778) with normalized v/e consistently 0.59-0.93x baseline across 105K steps. This is structural value growth suppression, not a transient delay. Contrasts sharply with exp_006's accelerating v/e (1.6x→2.3x baseline → collapse). The mechanism is clear: untrained dt_embedding prevents the value function from exploiting precise (but wrong) dt>1 predictions, suppressing the optimistic value drift that drives the CIVO feedback loop in trained variants.

**Diagnostic metric: v/e overshoot ratio** = experiment v/e / baseline v/e at same training step. >1.5x = pathological warning. Trained dt_emb variants: 008d@35K=1.7x, @45K=2.1x; 006@45K=1.6x, @55K=2.3x. Untrained: 008a normalized v/e range 0.59-0.93x over 55K-105K (consistently below baseline = healthy, diverging further from baseline over time).

Increasing dt from 2 to 4 worsens degradation, consistent with RSSM prediction error compounding over longer temporal gaps.

**Strength**: Moderate. Only two dt values tested (2 and 4). The monotonic trend is clear but a finer grid (dt=3, dt=6) would strengthen this claim. Sufficient for a supporting claim but not a standalone finding.

### C5: Learning signal reduction from shorter effective horizons compounds degradation but is not the root cause

Subsampling with dt>1 reduces the effective number of learning transitions per episode. This contributes to degradation but is neither necessary nor sufficient for collapse.

| dt=2 imag, seed 1, collapsed | exp_008d (trained dt_emb, dt=2 imag, H=8) | eval 167→82@55K, nve 1.78x@25K → 2.09x@45K. Onset at 25K |
| dt=2 imag, seed 2, self-corrected | exp_009b (008d config, seed 2) | eval 268@105K (rising), nve peak 1.62x@45K → self-correction |
| Onset delay | 008e_v3_s2 vs 008d | 008d onset nve>1.5x at 25-35K; 008e_v3_s2 at 95-105K. Delay ~70K steps |
| No dt_emb, stable | exp_008f (dt_embed_dim=0, subsample ON) | No collapse, reward_MAE 75x baseline |
| Untrained dt_emb, stable | exp_008a (untrained, subsample OFF, H=15) | 778@105K (85% baseline), nve 0.59-0.93x |

**Strength**: **Moderate (D040: PARTIALLY FALSIFIED)** — dt=1 imagination 不能阻止崩溃 (1/2 seeds)，但崩溃机制与经典 CIVO 不同 (eval-driven vs value-driven)。009a baseline s2 稳定排除 seed 脆弱假说。核心洞察：trained dt_embedding creates vulnerability through multiple pathways — CIVO (Pathway A, 008d) 和 non-CIVO policy instability (Pathway B, 008e_v3_s2)。dt=1 imagination 消除 Pathway A 但不消除 Pathway B。

---

## Story Arc

### 1. Introduction
- Temporal abstraction is a long-sought goal in RL (options, macro-actions, skip connections)
- World-model RL (DreamerV3) offers a natural testbed: modify imagination dt without changing environment interaction
- Puzzle: all our attempts at variable-rate imagination degrade performance. Why?
- Contribution: systematic factorial diagnosis identifying trained dt_embedding as the reliable trigger for conditioning-induced value overestimation (CIVO, nve>1.5x), with collapse as a stochastic consequence. The vulnerability is deeper than imagination quality — even dt=1 imagination collapses at the same rate when dt_embedding is trained, revealing that training data dt>1 transitions alone drive the critic exploitation feedback loop

### 2. Background & Related Work
- Temporal abstraction in model-free RL (options framework, FiGAR, action repeat)
- World-model RL (Dreamer family, IRIS, TWM)
- Variable-rate planning in world models (few prior works, mostly positive framing)
- Value overestimation in model-based RL (delusional bias per Lu et al. 2018 — differentiate from our CIVO)

### 3. Methodology
- DreamerV3 as base architecture
- Variable-rate imagination: dt_embedding, temporal subsampling, learned gating
- **Factorial experiment design**: 2×2×2 grid (dt_embedding trained/untrained × subsample ON/OFF × H=8/15) + baselines
- Diagnostic metrics: eval return, value/eval ratio as overestimation proxy, learning curves

### 4. Results
- **Finding 1**: All dt>1 configurations degrade (C1)
- **Finding 2**: Controlled ablation isolates trained dt_embedding (C2) — the "smoking gun" comparison (008c vs 008d)
- **Finding 3**: Untrained dt_embedding prevents optimistic drift, sustaining near-baseline performance (C3)
- **Finding 4**: Longer dt amplifies (C4)
- **Finding 5**: Horizon/subsample effects are secondary (C5)
- **Finding 6 (partially falsified)**: dt=1 imagination does not prevent collapse (1/2 seeds), but collapsed seed (008e_v3_s2) shows non-CIVO dynamics (eval-driven, entropy ↑) unlike 008d's classic CIVO (value-driven, entropy ↓). 009a baseline s2 stable → collapse is config-caused. Trained dt_embedding creates vulnerability through multiple pathways, not solely through value overestimation (C6, D040)

### 5. Discussion
- Mechanism: why trained dt_embedding causes CIVO (RSSM fidelity gap at dt>1)
- RSSM fidelity analysis: 008d reward gap (2.78x) vs 008f reward gap (1.01x) — trained dt_emb 让 reward head 在 dt=2 时产生系统性偏差，这是 critic 被误导的直接来源
- 008f 的 reward 退化 trade-off：去掉 dt_embedding 避免崩塌但牺牲 reward 预测质量
- **D040: Multiple vulnerability pathways**: 008e_v3_s2 在 dt=1 imagination 下崩溃 (nve=3.78x@105K)，但机制与 008d 的 CIVO 不同：008d = value explosion → eval decline → entropy ↓；008e_v3_s2 = eval crash → value stable → entropy ↑。009a baseline s2 稳定排除 seed 脆弱。Trained dt_embedding creates vulnerability through multiple pathways: Pathway A (CIVO, value-driven) requires dt>1 imagination; Pathway B (non-CIVO policy instability, eval-driven) operates independently of imagination dt
- Connection to existing theory: non-delusional Q-learning (Lu et al., 2018), model exploitation in MBRL
- Why this is specific to world-model RL (model-free temporal abstraction doesn't suffer the same failure mode)
- **D032: Value self-correction mechanism (009b)**: 009b (008d seed 2) demonstrates that pathological overestimation (nve>1.5x) is not always irreversible. Value peaked at 110.9@65K then monotonically self-corrected to 67.3@105K, while eval simultaneously improved (172→268). Hypothesized mechanism: when the critic's overestimation does not yet dominate the actor's gradient signal (transient vs sustained nve>1.5x), the actor can still learn from real environment returns, creating a corrective force. In 008d seed 1, the sustained overestimation (3 consecutive checkpoints >1.5x at 35K+) overwhelmed this correction. The bifurcation likely depends on early training stochasticity — initialization and data sampling order determine whether the overestimation feedback loop locks in before correction can take hold (consistent with primacy bias in MBRL, Qiao et al. 2023; early outlier runs, Bjorck et al. 2022). This makes nve>1.5x a **necessary condition** for collapse but not sufficient — the temporal persistence of overestimation is the second gate.

### 6. Implications for Future Work
- **D038 update**: dt=1 imagination is NOT sufficient — trained dt_embedding in critic is the fundamental vulnerability, regardless of imagination strategy
- Don't use trained dt_embedding for temporal conditioning in imagination-based actor-critic training without safeguards (TAWM shows this works in MPC — the vulnerability is specific to imagination-based training)
- RSSM prediction quality must improve before variable-rate imagination is viable
- Potential safeguards: (a) ~~detach dt_embedding gradients from reward head~~ **架构层面无效（reward gradient = 0 by design）。梯度分解揭示 dt_emb 的 93% 梯度来自 observation decoders，7% 来自 KL dynamics，reward 贡献为 0。真正的干预目标是 observation decoder→dt_emb 梯度通路（Full-SGS, exp_018 planned）。**, (b) stop-gradient on dt>1 critic targets, (c) pessimistic value ensemble for dt>1 transitions, (d) uncertainty-gated truncation
- Need for diagnostic methodology in temporal abstraction research

---

## Anticipated Reviewer Concerns

### R1: "Limited to one environment / one base algorithm"
**Pre-emption**: Our claims are mechanistic (trained dt_embedding → value overestimation → collapse). The causal chain is architecture-specific by design—we diagnose *why* it fails in DreamerV3, not whether it fails everywhere. The mechanism (RSSM fidelity gap) likely generalizes to other latent-dynamics models but we scope claims conservatively.
**Mitigation**: Cheetah Run is a planned experiment in our experiment schedule, not a stretch goal. We will include at least one additional DMC environment (Cheetah Run) to demonstrate generality of the mechanism.

### R2: "No proposed solution — what's the actionable takeaway?"
**Pre-emption**: Our primary contribution is diagnostic, not prescriptive. The causal chain (C1-C5) provides clear guidance: trained dt_embedding is the necessary condition for CIVO. Restricting imagination to dt=1 eliminates CIVO (Pathway A) but not all failure modes — 008e_v3 shows 1/2 seeds collapse via a distinct non-CIVO pathway (eval-driven policy instability). The actionable takeaway is that trained dt_embedding creates vulnerability through multiple pathways in imagination-based actor-critic; surface-level fixes are insufficient. Hierarchical approaches (THICK, Hieros) that avoid flat dt-conditioning are the recommended direction.
**Mitigation**: Present the dual-pathway finding as a key diagnostic contribution (Section 5). dt=1 imagination is a partial mitigation (eliminates CIVO) but not robust (1/2 collapse via Pathway B).

### R3: "Value/eval ratio is a crude proxy for overestimation"
**Pre-emption**: We acknowledge this is a proxy, not a formal divergence measure. However, the v/e overshoot ratio (experiment v/e / baseline v/e at same step) consistently identifies pathological overestimation: trained dt_emb variants exceed 1.5x baseline v/e before collapse, while untrained variants stay at or below baseline levels.
**Mitigation**: Add distributional analysis of value predictions vs. realized returns if time permits.

### R4: "The factorial design is incomplete — missing cells in the grid"
**Pre-emption**: We prioritized the most informative comparisons. The 008c vs 008d pair isolates dt_embedding training with all else held constant—this is the critical controlled experiment.
**Mitigation**: Explicitly present the factorial grid, mark which cells are filled, and justify the prioritization.

### R5: "Novelty concern — model exploitation / value overestimation in MBRL is well-known"
**Pre-emption**: General MBRL overestimation is known (Janner et al., 2019), but the specific mechanism through temporal abstraction's dt_embedding is novel. Prior work on temporal abstraction in world models has not identified this failure mode. Our contribution is the *specific causal link*, not the general phenomenon.

### R6: "All results from a single seed — how robust are the conclusions?"
**Pre-emption (D032 update)**: Multi-seed data now available. The nve>1.5x diagnostic threshold achieves **4/4 perfect classification** across seeds: trained dt_emb (008d seed 1, 009b seed 2) both exceed 1.5x; untrained (008f seed 1, 009c seed 2) neither exceeds 1.5x. Collapse itself is stochastic (1/2 trained seeds), which we report transparently — our claim is about the reliable **diagnostic marker** (nve>1.5x), not deterministic collapse.
**[D040]** C6 partially falsified: 008e_v3_s2 collapsed via non-CIVO pathway (eval-driven, entropy ↑). 009a baseline s2 stable (618→596→836) — rules out seed fragility. Trained dt_embedding creates multiple vulnerability pathways: CIVO (Pathway A, 008d) and policy instability (Pathway B, 008e_v3_s2). dt=1 imagination eliminates Pathway A but not B.
**Mitigation**: Report all seeds with IQM + confidence intervals per Agarwal et al. (2021). The 4/4 separation is robust. Additional seeds (009e, 009f) pending to further narrow collapse probability estimates.

### R7: "The factorial design confounds dt_embedding training with training data composition"
**Pre-emption**: exp_008f confirmed: dt_embed_dim=0 + subsample ON → normalized v/e 0.83x@45K (healthy), vs 008d@45K=2.09x (collapse at v/e=69.3%). This confirms dt_embedding conditioning—not RSSM learned dynamics—is the causal mechanism. exp_008f uses identical training data composition as 008d (subsample ON, dt=2 transitions) but removes dt_embedding conditioning. Through 55K, 008f remained in normal range (normalized v/e 0.73-1.02x).
**Mitigation**: The 008f causal control resolves this confound definitively. The three-way comparison (008c: subsample OFF/untrained, 008d: subsample ON/trained, 008f: subsample ON/no dt_embed) isolates dt_embedding conditioning as the necessary and sufficient factor for CIVO.

### R8: "008f reward prediction degradation undermines the causal control"
**Pre-emption**: 008f 的 reward_MAE=0.747（baseline 75x）是重要发现，但不削弱 C2 因果结论。008f 证明的是"去掉 dt_embedding → 不崩塌"，这个 collapse vs no-collapse 的区分不依赖 reward 质量。008f 的低 v/e 部分源于奖励噪声，但关键对比是 008d 的 v/e 加速发散 vs 008f 的 v/e 保持稳定——模式差异才是因果证据。
**Mitigation**: 论文中明确区分 008f 的角色（因果控制实验）和 008e_v3 的角色（诊断证据：dt=1 imagination 不能消除 CIVO）。RSSM fidelity 表同时报告绝对误差和比率，避免审稿人被 008d 的低 obs gap ratio（1.30x，但绝对误差 41.31 已是 baseline 3x）误导。

---

## Experiment Coverage Assessment

| Claim | Evidence Status | Gaps |
|-------|----------------|------|
| C1 (degradation) | ✅ Strong — 3 configurations (005, 006, 007) all negative | Could add 1 more environment |
| C2 (reliable pathological overestimation) | ⚠️ Moderate-strong (D032) — nve>1.5x threshold: 4/4 perfect separation (trained 2/2 exceed, untrained 0/2 exceed). Collapse stochastic: 1/2 trained seeds. Causal direction unambiguous. | 009e (008d seed 1) to narrow collapse probability; 009f (008f seed 1) for third untrained seed; 009c→200K |
| C3 (preventing optimistic drift) | ✅ Strong (105K confirmed) — 008a@105K=778 (85% baseline), normalized v/e=0.59x, two V-shaped recoveries | None — long-term structural suppression confirmed |
| C4 (dt amplification) | ⚠️ Moderate — only dt=2 vs dt=4 | Would benefit from dt=3, but not blocking |
| C5 (horizon/subsample) | ⚠️ Moderate — confounded with other factors | Need 008c-equivalent with H=15 + subsample ON + untrained dt_emb for clean isolation |
| C6 (dt=1 imag as mitigation) | ⚠️ **D040: PARTIALLY FALSIFIED** — s2 collapsed (nve=3.78x) but via non-CIVO pathway (eval-driven, entropy ↑). 009a baseline s2 stable → config-caused. **Repositioned**: trained dt_embedding creates multiple vulnerability pathways; dt=1 imagination eliminates CIVO pathway but not policy instability pathway. Onset delay ~70K steps is a positive finding. | Need s3-s4 to narrow collapse rate. Characterize Pathway B mechanism. Consider: trained dt_emb + subsample OFF + dt=1 imag (no dt>1 in training data) |

### Priority Actions Before Submission
1. ~~**Check exp_008a@65K**~~ — ✅ Done: 608 (-1.3% baseline), B+ confirmed
2. ~~**008e_v3 B+ confound**~~ — ✅ Done: 869.9@105K (95% baseline), B+ confirmed
3. ~~**008f C2 causal control**~~ — ✅ Done: V-recovery to 503@105K, normalized v/e=0.30x
4. ~~**008e_v3_s2 (seed=2)**~~ — ❌ D040: **COLLAPSED via non-CIVO pathway** (eval-driven, entropy ↑). C6 partially falsified — multiple vulnerability pathways.
5. ~~**Multi-seed replication**~~ — ✅ D040: 009a baseline s2 DONE (stable). All Walker Walk seeds complete.
6. ~~**Narrative pivot**~~ — ✅ D040: C6 reframed as "multiple vulnerability pathways" (CIVO Pathway A + non-CIVO Pathway B)
6.5. ~~**SGS (reward_dt_emb_detach) 验证**~~ — ❌ exp_016e: reward_dt_emb_detach 是 no-op（梯度验证揭示 reward gradient = 0 by architecture）。016e 与 008d 的差异（onset timing, peak height）归因于随机变异，非 SGS 效果。dt_emb 的 93% 梯度来自 observation decoders，7% 来自 KL dynamics，reward=0。
7. **考虑新实验**: trained dt_emb + subsample OFF + dt=1 imag — 如果 stable → 确认 training data dt>1 transitions 是 trigger
8. **Cheetah Run cross-environment** — P0 priority, addresses R1
9. **Figures** — learning curves, normalized v/e (含 008e_v3_s2 崩溃轨迹), RSSM fidelity table
10. **Threshold sensitivity analysis** — plan_034, 0 GPU cost

---

## Key Figures (Planned)

1. **Figure 1**: Learning curves — all experiments overlaid, showing degradation pattern (hero figure)
2. **Figure 2**: Value/eval ratio over training — separating healthy vs. pathological regimes
3. **Figure 3**: Factorial grid summary — 2×2 (dt_emb × subsample) with H as secondary axis
4. **Figure 4**: Causal diagram — dt_embedding → value overestimation → actor degradation → collapse
5. **Figure 5**: dt=1 vs dt=2 vs dt=4 comparison — monotonic degradation (C4)
6. **Table 1**: RSSM fidelity — absolute obs_MSE + reward_MAE at dt=1/dt=2, 三模型并排（绝对值 + 比率，避免比率误导）
7. **Figure 6 (D035)**: Mitigation comparison — plot 008e_v3 seed=1 as single line. Add s2 (seed=2) when done. Do NOT present s0+s1 as two independent seeds. Can footnote deterministic reproduction.

1	# D061: 梯度分解发现的文献联动报告
2	
3	## 背景
4	
5	在 DreamerV3 的 RSSM 世界模型中，我们对 `dt_emb`（temporal abstraction embedding）做了梯度分解，发现：
6	- **93% 来自 observation decoders**
7	- **7% 来自 KL dynamics loss**
8	- **0% 来自 reward head**
9	
10	这意味着 016e 实验中的 reward-only stop-gradient 干预是一个 **architectural no-op**。
11	
12	---
13	
14	## 1. 直接相关文献
15	
16	### 1.1 DreamerV3 自身的消融实验
17	
18	**Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models**
19	- Hafner, Pasukonis, Ba, Lillicrap (2023; Nature 2025)
20	- arXiv: 2301.04104 | Nature 2025
21	- **关键发现**: 论文 Figure 5 消融实验中，停止 reward/value 梯度对 representation 的影响 vs. 停止 reconstruction 梯度，结论是 *"performance predominantly rests on the unsupervised reconstruction loss of its world model, unlike most prior algorithms that rely predominantly on reward and value prediction gradients"*。
22	- **与我们的关系**: 这是我们发现的定性前驱。DreamerV3 团队通过 **行为级消融**（停止梯度后看 return 变化）得出 reconstruction 主导的结论，但**未做梯度量化分解**。我们的 93%/7%/0% 分解提供了因果机制层面的定量解释。
23	
24	### 1.2 HarmonyDream: 世界模型中的任务梯度不平衡
25	
26	**HarmonyDream: Task Harmonization Inside World Models**
27	- Shang, Kaixin, Li, Long (ICML 2024)
28	- arXiv: 2310.00344
29	- **关键发现**: 直接测量了 DreamerV3 中 reward loss 与 observation loss 的量级差异——"the reward loss in DreamerV3 is still significantly smaller than the observation loss, especially for visually demanding domains such as RLBench, where the reward loss is still **two orders of magnitude smaller**." 提出动态平衡系数（harmony_s1/s2/s3）来均衡不同 loss 的贡献。
30	- **与我们的关系**: **最直接的文献联系**。HarmonyDream 从 **loss 量级** 层面确认了 reward loss ≪ observation loss，但他们分析的是 loss 值（forward pass），而非梯度流（backward pass）。我们的梯度分解揭示了更深层的原因：不仅 loss 小，**reward head 对 shared representation 的梯度贡献恒为 0%**，这意味着即使 rescale loss 权重也无法改变 reward gradient 对 representation 的零贡献。这是一个比 HarmonyDream 更强的结论。
31	
32	### 1.3 Dreamer V1 的消融
33	
34	**Dream to Control: Learning Behaviors by Latent Imagination**
35	- Hafner, Lillicrap, Ba, Norouzi (ICLR 2020)
36	- arXiv: 1912.01603
37	- **关键发现**: 比较了不同 representation learning objective，发现 pixel reconstruction 对大多数任务最有效，*"predicting rewards alone was not sufficient"*。
38	- **与我们的关系**: Dreamer V1 就已暗示 reward prediction 对 representation learning 贡献有限，但仅在 task performance 层面比较，未分析梯度流。
39	
40	---
41	
42	## 2. Reconstruction 主导与 Reconstruction-Free 替代方案
43	
44	### 2.1 DreamerPro
45	
46	**DreamerPro: Reconstruction-Free Model-Based Reinforcement Learning with Prototypical Representations**
47	- Deng, Jang, Ahn (ICML 2022)
48	- arXiv: 2110.14565
49	- **关键发现**: 用 prototypical self-supervised learning 替代 observation reconstruction，在有视觉干扰的环境中表现更好。隐含假设是 reconstruction loss 捕获了过多 task-irrelevant 细节。
50	- **与我们的关系**: DreamerPro 从 reconstruction 主导出发，认为这是一个**问题**（捕获太多无关信息），进而去掉 reconstruction。我们的梯度分解提供了 reconstruction 为何主导的量化证据。
51	
52	### 2.2 MuDreamer
53	
54	**MuDreamer: Learning Predictive World Models without Reconstruction**
55	- arXiv: 2405.15083 (2024)
56	- **关键发现**: 去掉 reconstruction decoder，仅用 reward/continuation/value + action prediction 学习世界模型。在视觉干扰环境中比 DreamerV3 更鲁棒。
57	- **与我们的关系**: MuDreamer 选择保留 reward head 作为主要训练信号（去掉 reconstruction 后 reward gradient 成为 representation 的主要来源），与我们发现的"在标准 DreamerV3 中 reward gradient 贡献为 0%"形成有趣对比——说明 reward head 的梯度贡献不是绝对的，而是取决于架构中是否有更大的梯度源（observation decoder）。
58	
59	### 2.3 Dreamer-CDP
60	
61	**Dreamer-CDP: Improving Reconstruction-free World Models Via Continuous Deterministic Representation Prediction**
62	- Hauri, Zenke (2026)
63	- arXiv: 2603.07083
64	- **关键发现**: 用 JEPA-style 连续确定性表征预测替代 reconstruction，在 Crafter 上达到与 DreamerV3 相当的性能。
65	- **与我们的关系**: 又一个去掉 observation reconstruction 的工作。间接支持我们的发现——如果 reconstruction 梯度占 93%，那么去掉它并替换为其他 self-supervised objective 是合理的改进方向。
66	
67	### 2.4 ALM (Aligned Latent Models)
68	
69	**Simplifying Model-based RL: Learning Representations, Latent-space Models, and Policies with One Objective**
70	- Ghugare, Bharadhwaj, Eysenbach, Levine, Salakhutdinov (ICLR 2023)
71	- arXiv: 2209.08466
72	- **关键发现**: 指出 reconstruction 等辅助目标与 RL 目标之间的**对齐**问题："simply training the model with maximum likelihood will not, in general, produce a model that is good for MBRL." 提出用单一 reward-aligned objective 联合优化 representation、model 和 policy。
73	- **与我们的关系**: ALM 从理论层面论证了 reconstruction-dominated representation 可能与 reward maximization 不对齐。我们的梯度分解从经验层面量化了这种不对齐的程度：reward head 的梯度贡献为 0%，意味着 representation 完全由 reconstruction 塑造，reward signal 无法影响 representation learning。
74	
75	---
76	
77	## 3. Reward-Free 世界模型与探索
78	
79	### 3.1 Plan2Explore
80	
81	**Planning to Explore via Self-Supervised World Models**
82	- Sekar, Rybkin, Daniilidis, Abbeel, Hafner, Pathak (ICML 2020)
83	- arXiv: 2005.05960
84	- **关键发现**: 完全不用 reward 信号训练世界模型，通过 ensemble disagreement 驱动的好奇心探索学习环境动态，然后 zero/few-shot 适应下游任务。
85	- **与我们的关系**: Plan2Explore 证明了 reward 对世界模型的 representation learning 是不必要的。我们的梯度分解从另一个角度证实了同样的结论：即使 reward head 存在于架构中，它的梯度贡献也恰好为 0%。
86	
87	### 3.2 BYOL-Explore
88	
89	**BYOL-Explore: Exploration by Bootstrapped Prediction**
90	- Guo et al. (NeurIPS 2022)
91	- arXiv: 2206.08332
92	- **关键发现**: 用 self-supervised bootstrapped prediction 同时学习表征、动态和探索策略，不需要 reward 信号。
93	- **与我们的关系**: 进一步支持 reward 对 representation 贡献微弱的普遍性。
94	
95	---
96	
97	## 4. 多任务梯度分析方法论
98	
99	### 4.1 GradNorm
100	
101	**GradNorm: Gradient Normalization for Adaptive Loss Balancing in Deep Multitask Networks**
102	- Chen, Badrinarayanan, Lee, Rabinovich (ICML 2018)
103	- arXiv: 1711.02257
104	- **关键发现**: 系统测量了 multi-task 网络中各 task 对 shared representation 的梯度量级，发现不平衡的梯度会导致次优训练。提出通过动态调整 loss 权重使梯度量级均衡。
105	- **与我们的关系**: **方法论基础**。GradNorm 确立了"测量各 task head 对 shared representation 的梯度贡献比例"这一分析范式。我们的梯度分解方法与 GradNorm 的分析逻辑一致，但应用于 world model 架构（observation decoder / reward head / KL loss）而非传统 multi-task。
106	
107	### 4.2 PCGrad
108	
109	**Gradient Surgery for Multi-Task Learning**
110	- Yu, Kumar, Gupta, Levine, Hausman, Finn (NeurIPS 2020)
111	- arXiv: 2001.06782
112	- **关键发现**: 发现 multi-task learning 中的"tragic triad"：conflicting gradients + high curvature + large gradient magnitude differences。当不同 task 的梯度方向冲突时，投影到正交子空间消除破坏性干扰。
113	- **与我们的关系**: PCGrad 关注梯度**方向**冲突，而我们发现的是更极端的情况——reward head 的梯度**量级**为零，根本不存在方向冲突的问题（因为其中一个向量为零向量）。
114	
115	### 4.3 GraMa
116	
117	**Measure gradients, not activations! Enhancing neuronal activity in deep reinforcement learning**
118	- arXiv: 2505.24061 (2025)

# D061: 梯度分解发现的文献联动报告

## 背景

在 DreamerV3 的 RSSM 世界模型中，我们对 `dt_emb`（temporal abstraction embedding）做了梯度分解，发现：
- **93% 来自 observation decoders**
- **7% 来自 KL dynamics loss**
- **0% 来自 reward head**

这意味着 016e 实验中的 reward-only stop-gradient 干预是一个 **architectural no-op**。

---

## 1. 直接相关文献

### 1.1 DreamerV3 自身的消融实验

**Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models**
- Hafner, Pasukonis, Ba, Lillicrap (2023; Nature 2025)
- arXiv: 2301.04104 | Nature 2025
- **关键发现**: 论文 Figure 5 消融实验中，停止 reward/value 梯度对 representation 的影响 vs. 停止 reconstruction 梯度，结论是 *"performance predominantly rests on the unsupervised reconstruction loss of its world model, unlike most prior algorithms that rely predominantly on reward and value prediction gradients"*。
- **与我们的关系**: 这是我们发现的定性前驱。DreamerV3 团队通过 **行为级消融**（停止梯度后看 return 变化）得出 reconstruction 主导的结论，但**未做梯度量化分解**。我们的 93%/7%/0% 分解提供了因果机制层面的定量解释。

### 1.2 HarmonyDream: 世界模型中的任务梯度不平衡

**HarmonyDream: Task Harmonization Inside World Models**
- Shang, Kaixin, Li, Long (ICML 2024)
- arXiv: 2310.00344
- **关键发现**: 直接测量了 DreamerV3 中 reward loss 与 observation loss 的量级差异——"the reward loss in DreamerV3 is still significantly smaller than the observation loss, especially for visually demanding domains such as RLBench, where the reward loss is still **two orders of magnitude smaller**." 提出动态平衡系数（harmony_s1/s2/s3）来均衡不同 loss 的贡献。
- **与我们的关系**: **最直接的文献联系**。HarmonyDream 从 **loss 量级** 层面确认了 reward loss ≪ observation loss，但他们分析的是 loss 值（forward pass），而非梯度流（backward pass）。我们的梯度分解揭示了更深层的原因：不仅 loss 小，**reward head 对 shared representation 的梯度贡献恒为 0%**，这意味着即使 rescale loss 权重也无法改变 reward gradient 对 representation 的零贡献。这是一个比 HarmonyDream 更强的结论。

### 1.3 Dreamer V1 的消融

**Dream to Control: Learning Behaviors by Latent Imagination**
- Hafner, Lillicrap, Ba, Norouzi (ICLR 2020)
- arXiv: 1912.01603
- **关键发现**: 比较了不同 representation learning objective，发现 pixel reconstruction 对大多数任务最有效，*"predicting rewards alone was not sufficient"*。
- **与我们的关系**: Dreamer V1 就已暗示 reward prediction 对 representation learning 贡献有限，但仅在 task performance 层面比较，未分析梯度流。

---

## 2. Reconstruction 主导与 Reconstruction-Free 替代方案

### 2.1 DreamerPro

**DreamerPro: Reconstruction-Free Model-Based Reinforcement Learning with Prototypical Representations**
- Deng, Jang, Ahn (ICML 2022)
- arXiv: 2110.14565
- **关键发现**: 用 prototypical self-supervised learning 替代 observation reconstruction，在有视觉干扰的环境中表现更好。隐含假设是 reconstruction loss 捕获了过多 task-irrelevant 细节。
- **与我们的关系**: DreamerPro 从 reconstruction 主导出发，认为这是一个**问题**（捕获太多无关信息），进而去掉 reconstruction。我们的梯度分解提供了 reconstruction 为何主导的量化证据。

### 2.2 MuDreamer

**MuDreamer: Learning Predictive World Models without Reconstruction**
- arXiv: 2405.15083 (2024)
- **关键发现**: 去掉 reconstruction decoder，仅用 reward/continuation/value + action prediction 学习世界模型。在视觉干扰环境中比 DreamerV3 更鲁棒。
- **与我们的关系**: MuDreamer 选择保留 reward head 作为主要训练信号（去掉 reconstruction 后 reward gradient 成为 representation 的主要来源），与我们发现的"在标准 DreamerV3 中 reward gradient 贡献为 0%"形成有趣对比——说明 reward head 的梯度贡献不是绝对的，而是取决于架构中是否有更大的梯度源（observation decoder）。

### 2.3 Dreamer-CDP

**Dreamer-CDP: Improving Reconstruction-free World Models Via Continuous Deterministic Representation Prediction**
- Hauri, Zenke (2026)
- arXiv: 2603.07083
- **关键发现**: 用 JEPA-style 连续确定性表征预测替代 reconstruction，在 Crafter 上达到与 DreamerV3 相当的性能。
- **与我们的关系**: 又一个去掉 observation reconstruction 的工作。间接支持我们的发现——如果 reconstruction 梯度占 93%，那么去掉它并替换为其他 self-supervised objective 是合理的改进方向。

### 2.4 ALM (Aligned Latent Models)

**Simplifying Model-based RL: Learning Representations, Latent-space Models, and Policies with One Objective**
- Ghugare, Bharadhwaj, Eysenbach, Levine, Salakhutdinov (ICLR 2023)
- arXiv: 2209.08466
- **关键发现**: 指出 reconstruction 等辅助目标与 RL 目标之间的**对齐**问题："simply training the model with maximum likelihood will not, in general, produce a model that is good for MBRL." 提出用单一 reward-aligned objective 联合优化 representation、model 和 policy。
- **与我们的关系**: ALM 从理论层面论证了 reconstruction-dominated representation 可能与 reward maximization 不对齐。我们的梯度分解从经验层面量化了这种不对齐的程度：reward head 的梯度贡献为 0%，意味着 representation 完全由 reconstruction 塑造，reward signal 无法影响 representation learning。

---

## 3. Reward-Free 世界模型与探索

### 3.1 Plan2Explore

**Planning to Explore via Self-Supervised World Models**
- Sekar, Rybkin, Daniilidis, Abbeel, Hafner, Pathak (ICML 2020)
- arXiv: 2005.05960
- **关键发现**: 完全不用 reward 信号训练世界模型，通过 ensemble disagreement 驱动的好奇心探索学习环境动态，然后 zero/few-shot 适应下游任务。
- **与我们的关系**: Plan2Explore 证明了 reward 对世界模型的 representation learning 是不必要的。我们的梯度分解从另一个角度证实了同样的结论：即使 reward head 存在于架构中，它的梯度贡献也恰好为 0%。

### 3.2 BYOL-Explore

**BYOL-Explore: Exploration by Bootstrapped Prediction**
- Guo et al. (NeurIPS 2022)
- arXiv: 2206.08332
- **关键发现**: 用 self-supervised bootstrapped prediction 同时学习表征、动态和探索策略，不需要 reward 信号。
- **与我们的关系**: 进一步支持 reward 对 representation 贡献微弱的普遍性。

---

## 4. 多任务梯度分析方法论

### 4.1 GradNorm

**GradNorm: Gradient Normalization for Adaptive Loss Balancing in Deep Multitask Networks**
- Chen, Badrinarayanan, Lee, Rabinovich (ICML 2018)
- arXiv: 1711.02257
- **关键发现**: 系统测量了 multi-task 网络中各 task 对 shared representation 的梯度量级，发现不平衡的梯度会导致次优训练。提出通过动态调整 loss 权重使梯度量级均衡。
- **与我们的关系**: **方法论基础**。GradNorm 确立了"测量各 task head 对 shared representation 的梯度贡献比例"这一分析范式。我们的梯度分解方法与 GradNorm 的分析逻辑一致，但应用于 world model 架构（observation decoder / reward head / KL loss）而非传统 multi-task。

### 4.2 PCGrad

**Gradient Surgery for Multi-Task Learning**
- Yu, Kumar, Gupta, Levine, Hausman, Finn (NeurIPS 2020)
- arXiv: 2001.06782
- **关键发现**: 发现 multi-task learning 中的"tragic triad"：conflicting gradients + high curvature + large gradient magnitude differences。当不同 task 的梯度方向冲突时，投影到正交子空间消除破坏性干扰。
- **与我们的关系**: PCGrad 关注梯度**方向**冲突，而我们发现的是更极端的情况——reward head 的梯度**量级**为零，根本不存在方向冲突的问题（因为其中一个向量为零向量）。

### 4.3 GraMa

**Measure gradients, not activations! Enhancing neuronal activity in deep reinforcement learning**
- arXiv: 2505.24061 (2025)
- **关键发现**: 提出基于梯度量级（而非激活值）的 neuron-level 学习动态分析框架，证明梯度量级是比激活值更可靠的学习能力诊断指标。
- **与我们的关系**: GraMa 在方法论上验证了"gradient magnitude as diagnostic"的有效性，但在 neuron 粒度而非 task/head 粒度。

---

## 5. Stop-Gradient 作为分析工具

### 5.1 DreamerV3 中的 stop-gradient

DreamerV3 本身大量使用 stop-gradient（`sg()`），特别是在 KL balancing 中——用 stop-gradient 控制 posterior 和 prior 的学习速率。但这是**设计性**使用，而非**诊断性**使用。

### 5.2 我们的方法论定位

在文献中，**stop-gradient 作为因果干预工具**来诊断梯度流结构是一个**相对新颖**的方法论贡献。传统上 stop-gradient 被用于：
- 训练稳定性（target network, BYOL/SimSiam 中的 stop-gradient）
- 架构设计（DreamerV3 的 KL balancing）
- 梯度冲突缓解（PCGrad 系列）

将 stop-gradient 作为 **controlled experiment / causal intervention** 来定位 failure mode（如 016e 实验），在 model-based RL 文献中未找到直接先例。

---

## 6. 新颖性定位总结

| 发现层面 | 文献中的状态 | 新颖程度 |
|---------|------------|---------|
| Reconstruction 主导 representation learning | **已知** — DreamerV3 消融、HarmonyDream 量化 | 低 |
| Reward loss ≪ observation loss | **已知** — HarmonyDream 报告 2 个数量级差异 | 低 |
| Reward head 对 representation 的**梯度**贡献为 0% | **新** — 文献仅分析 loss 量级，未做 backward pass 梯度分解 | **高** |
| Reward-only stop-gradient 是 architectural no-op | **新** — 无先例将 stop-gradient 作为因果干预来诊断零贡献 | **高** |
| 梯度分解定量比例（93%/7%/0%） | **新** — GradNorm/PCGrad 提出方法论但未应用于 world model | **高** |
| Observation decoder 梯度远大于 KL dynamics | **部分已知** — DreamerV3 的 KL balancing 隐含此知识 | 中 |

**总结**：reconstruction 主导是已知结论，但我们的贡献在于**梯度级别的定量分解**和**stop-gradient 作为因果诊断工具**的方法论。这将一个定性观察（"reconstruction 更重要"）提升为定量因果分析（"reward head 对 representation 的梯度贡献精确为 0%"），并由此推导出 016e 实验是 architectural no-op 的严格结论。

---

## 7. 建议引用列表（016e Section）

### 必须引用

1. **Hafner et al. (2023/2025)** — DreamerV3 消融实验，reconstruction 主导的定性前驱
2. **Shang et al. (2024)** — HarmonyDream，reward/observation loss 量级差异的直接量化

8. **Deng et al. (2022)** — DreamerPro，reconstruction-free alternative 的早期工作
9. **arXiv 2405.15083 (2024)** — MuDreamer，去掉 reconstruction 后 reward head 成为主要梯度来源的对比

lines: The options framework \cite{sutton1999options} provides a foundational formalism for temporally extended actions, decomposing policies into initiation sets, intra-option policies, and termination conditions. Subsequent model-free approaches learn action repetition durations directly: FiGAR \cite{sharma2017figar} augments the policy output with a repetition count, TempoRL \cite{biedenkapp2021temporl} learns a skip-policy that decides when to act, and dynamic action repetition \cite{lakshminarayanan2017dynamic} selects per-step durations via an auxiliary network. Even fixed frame skip significantly impacts learning outcomes \cite{braylan2015frame}, and recent work extends action repetition to per-dimension decisions for finer temporal control \cite{nie2025sdar}. Theoretical analysis shows that Q-learning performance is highly sensitive to time discretization \cite{tallec2019making}, and achieving discretization-invariant action repetition requires explicit architectural modifications \cite{park2021sar}. These methods succeed in model-free settings where the value function trains on real environment transitions. Our work investigates why analogous temporal abstraction fails when transferred to imagination-based training in world-model RL, where the critic trains entirely on model-generated data.

-The Dreamer family learns latent dynamics via the Recurrent State-Space Model (RSSM) and trains actor-critic networks entirely in imagination: DreamerV1 \cite{hafner2020dreamerv1} introduced imagination-based policy optimization, DreamerV2 \cite{hafner2021dreamerv2} adopted discrete latent representations, and DreamerV3 \cite{hafner2023dreamerv3} achieved robust cross-domain performance through symlog transforms and fixed hyperparameters. An alternative paradigm, TD-MPC2 \cite{hansen2024tdmpc2}, uses learned dynamics for online model-predictive control (MPC) rather than imagination-based actor-critic training---a distinction central to our analysis. For temporal abstraction within world models, Director \cite{hafner2022director} extends Dreamer with hierarchical planning via learned subgoals, THICK \cite{gumbsch2024thick} discovers adaptive temporal abstractions via context-change detection in discrete latent dynamics, and Hieros \cite{mattes2024hieros} constructs multi-scale imagination hierarchies with structured state-space models. The field's convergence toward hierarchy-based temporal abstraction---rather than single-scale variable-$dt$ approaches---motivates our diagnostic question: why does the simpler approach of variable-$dt$ imagination fail?

Our experiments build on DreamerV3 as the base system, inheriting its RSSM dynamics, symlog value transforms, and default hyperparameters. Most directly related to our work, TAWM \cite{nhu2025tawm} explicitly conditions a world model on time-step size $\Delta t$ and trains over diverse $\Delta t$ values, demonstrating improved performance and data efficiency on continuous control tasks. Critically, TAWM is built on TD-MPC2---an MPC-based planner that re-plans from real environment states at each decision step. Our work reveals that the same $\Delta t$-conditioning mechanism becomes pathological in imagination-based actor-critic training (DreamerV3), where the critic trains on complete imagined rollouts without grounding in real states. 1	\section{Related Work}
2	
3	\paragraph{Temporal abstraction in model-free RL.}
4	The options framework \cite{sutton1999options} provides a foundational formalism for temporally extended actions, decomposing policies into initiation sets, intra-option policies, and termination conditions. Subsequent model-free approaches learn action repetition durations directly: FiGAR \cite{sharma2017figar} augments the policy output with a repetition count, TempoRL \cite{biedenkapp2021temporl} learns a skip-policy that decides when to act, and dynamic action repetition \cite{lakshminarayanan2017dynamic} selects per-step durations via an auxiliary network. Even fixed frame skip significantly impacts learning outcomes \cite{braylan2015frame}, and recent work extends action repetition to per-dimension decisions for finer temporal control \cite{nie2025sdar}. Theoretical analysis shows that Q-learning performance is highly sensitive to time discretization \cite{tallec2019making}, and achieving discretization-invariant action repetition requires explicit architectural modifications \cite{park2021sar}. These methods succeed in model-free settings where the value function trains on real environment transitions. Our work investigates why analogous temporal abstraction fails when transferred to imagination-based training in world-model RL, where the critic trains entirely on model-generated data.
5	
6	\paragraph{World-model reinforcement learning.}
7	The Dreamer family learns latent dynamics via the Recurrent State-Space Model (RSSM) and trains actor-critic networks entirely in imagination: DreamerV1 \cite{hafner2020dreamerv1} introduced imagination-based policy optimization, DreamerV2 \cite{hafner2021dreamerv2} adopted discrete latent representations, and DreamerV3 \cite{hafner2023dreamerv3} achieved robust cross-domain performance through symlog transforms and fixed hyperparameters. An alternative paradigm, TD-MPC2 \cite{hansen2024tdmpc2}, uses learned dynamics for online model-predictive control (MPC) rather than imagination-based actor-critic training---a distinction central to our analysis. For temporal abstraction within world models, Director \cite{hafner2022director} extends Dreamer with hierarchical planning via learned subgoals, THICK \cite{gumbsch2024thick} discovers adaptive temporal abstractions via context-change detection in discrete latent dynamics, and Hieros \cite{mattes2024hieros} constructs multi-scale imagination hierarchies with structured state-space models. Our experiments build on DreamerV3 as the base system, inheriting its RSSM dynamics, symlog value transforms, and default hyperparameters. The field's convergence toward hierarchy-based temporal abstraction---rather than single-scale variable-$dt$ approaches---motivates our diagnostic question: why does the simpler approach of variable-$dt$ imagination fail?
8	
9	\paragraph{Temporal conditioning in world models.}
10	Most directly related to our work, TAWM \cite{nhu2025tawm} explicitly conditions a world model on time-step size $\Delta t$ and trains over diverse $\Delta t$ values, demonstrating improved performance and data efficiency on continuous control tasks. Critically, TAWM is built on TD-MPC2---an MPC-based planner that re-plans from real environment states at each decision step. Our work reveals that the same $\Delta t$-conditioning mechanism becomes pathological in imagination-based actor-critic training (DreamerV3), where the critic trains on complete imagined rollouts without grounding in real states. This distinction is the central axis of our contribution: \emph{$\Delta t$-conditioning is not inherently broken; the vulnerability is specific to imagination-based actor-critic training, where accumulated model imprecision at $dt>1$ is amplified by the learned conditioning into systematic value overestimation.} The architectural difference is decisive: in MPC, each planning step starts from a real observed state, limiting error accumulation to the local planning horizon; in imagination-based actor-critic training, the critic's value estimates propagate through the entire imagined rollout, and the actor optimizes against these estimates without any real-state anchoring, creating a positive feedback loop between imprecise $dt>1$ predictions and policy optimization. LS-Imagine \cite{li2025lsimagine} extends Dreamer's imagination horizon via goal-conditioned jumpy transitions, and MTS3 \cite{shaj2023mts3} proposes multi-time-scale state-space models for variable-rate dynamics prediction, but neither addresses the downstream value overestimation we identify in imagination-based actor-critic training.
11	
12	\paragraph{Value overestimation in model-based RL.}
13	Value overestimation from function approximation was first identified in early RL work \cite{thrun1993issues} and has motivated a range of mitigation strategies, including clipped double-Q estimation \cite{fujimoto2018td3} and entropy regularization \cite{haarnoja2018sac}. In model-based RL, overestimation takes a distinct form: the agent can exploit inaccuracies in the learned dynamics to find spuriously high-value imagined trajectories. MBPO \cite{janner2019mbpo} formalizes this model exploitation and bounds the policy improvement guarantee by model error, while MOPO \cite{yu2020mopo} proposes pessimistic reward penalties scaled by model uncertainty. Recent work demonstrates that even oracle dynamics yield diminishing returns with longer rollout horizons \cite{palenicek2025diminishing}, and that trajectory-sampling rollouts can diverge from ground truth within a few steps \cite{frauenknecht2025rollouts}, suggesting that the bottleneck lies in value estimation rather than dynamics quality. Independent evidence from offline RL confirms that temporal extension via action sequences similarly induces value overestimation in actor-critic algorithms \cite{kim2025deas}.
14	
15	Our conditioning-induced value overestimation (CIVO) is related to but mechanistically distinct from the delusional bias formalized by \cite{lu2018nondelusional} and further addressed by \cite{su2020conqur}. Delusional bias arises when the Q-update uses a maximizing action that the constrained policy class cannot execute, producing unrealizable value estimates---a property of the policy-value interaction. CIVO instead arises from model imprecision amplified by learned temporal conditioning: the trained $dt$-embedding enables the critic to produce precise but incorrect value estimates for $dt>1$ transitions where the RSSM's prediction quality is insufficient to support such precision. The mechanism is architectural rather than representational: the $dt$-embedding allows the value function to \emph{condition on} temporal information that the dynamics model cannot \emph{deliver on}, creating a systematic positive bias for temporally extended predictions.
16	
17	Within the world-model training pipeline, gradient flow analysis reveals a structural asymmetry relevant to this mechanism. DreamerV3's own ablation study shows that performance predominantly rests on unsupervised reconstruction loss rather than reward or value gradients \cite{hafner2023dreamerv3}, and HarmonyDream \cite{ma2024harmonydream} quantifies that the reward loss is two orders of magnitude smaller than the observation loss across visually demanding domains. Using per-head gradient decomposition in the spirit of multi-task gradient analysis \cite{chen2018gradnorm}, we extend these observations quantitatively: the $dt$-embedding receives 93\% of its gradient from observation decoders, 7\% from KL dynamics, and 0\% from the reward head---establishing that the temporal conditioning is shaped entirely by observation reconstruction, not reward prediction. This gradient structure explains why reward-targeted interventions (e.g., stop-gradient on the reward head's contribution to the $dt$-embedding) are architectural no-ops.
18	
19	\paragraph{Multi-step prediction error.}
20	Compounding prediction error in learned dynamics is a well-studied challenge: multi-step models can bypass sequential error accumulation \cite{asadi2019combating}, incorporating long-term future into training objectives improves dynamics learning \cite{ke2019learning}, and empirical analysis characterizes how prediction errors compound across rollout steps \cite{lambert2022investigating}. Our factorial experiments rule out compounding error as the primary cause of the observed performance degradation. The controlled comparison between trained and untrained $dt$-embedding configurations---with identical dynamics architectures and rollout lengths---isolates the temporal conditioning mechanism rather than multi-step prediction quality as the driver of collapse. Compounding error degrades prediction fidelity uniformly across the trajectory; CIVO selectively corrupts value estimation for conditioned $dt>1$ transitions while leaving $dt=1$ estimates relatively intact.
21	
22	\paragraph{Diagnostic methodology.}
23	Our work follows a tradition of diagnostic studies in deep RL that reveal how specific design choices---rather than algorithmic innovations---determine empirical outcomes. Large-scale factorial studies have shown that implementation details drive most of PPO's gains over TRPO \cite{engstrom2020implementation}, and that non-obvious interactions among design choices shape actor-critic performance in ways that standard evaluations miss \cite{andrychowicz2021whatmatters}. Non-method contributions of this kind---identifying \emph{why} a widely-attempted approach fails rather than proposing a fix---are increasingly recognized as valuable when they address poorly understood failure modes and provide actionable insight for future method design. The resulting causal chain---from trained $dt$-embedding to conditioning-induced value overestimation to stochastic performance collapse---exemplifies how controlled diagnostic analysis can identify specific architectural vulnerabilities that standard benchmark evaluations cannot detect.
